New in this build: the rebuilt DRUM SEQUENCER, the only sequencer / piano roll screen in the app.
- Left: the sound library (every sound by type, search, import sounds or packs). Drag a sound onto the channel rack to add a channel; drop it on a channel to swap its sound; tap to load it onto the selected channel.
- Channel rack (up to 12): the triangle opens each track's piano roll in place, LEVEL and PAN knobs, the on/off lamp, and a dice per track that randomizes only that track.
- Step grid with 16 steps a bar, velocity lane, SNAP, SNAP TO SCALE, SWING, HUMANIZE, pinch to zoom.
- GENERATE panel: a new pattern in any genre. MIDI panel: MIDI out routing.
- PATTERN and KIT pickers with arrows at the bottom.
Please try dragging sounds onto the rack, opening a track's piano roll, and each dice.
